crop_processing.notes: Every saved crop was visually inspected. B01 and B08 were reopened without regenerating or altering their crops.

boxes.comments: The left group has recoverable r/e/l/a bodies, including a tall l loop, but heavy crossing or retracing through the lower connected strokes leaves its cancellation state unresolved. The first local alternatives explicitly retain that state uncertainty. The following t and dotted i are visible. The next two bodies are crossed by a large upper loop and oblique return; ve is tentative, and no complete independent older token can be recovered. The final low ment sequence and terminal t are retained. At the right, a tiny lower hooked mark and detached upper point favor à, with colon retained as the narrow graphical alternative. No complete word has been supplied from an external text.

The first word has c, compressed e/n, a short s and final e with a detached acute, read censé. The second has s, a short dotted i, g with a long left-returning descender, low n/i, a tall looped f, another dotted i and a final low e/r return ending in a downward hook, read signifier. Both words are complete inside the box; no punctuation is added.

The left word ends in a clear low n. Its initial current e has a small lower loop and additional dark upper strokes, so that initial is locally uncertain; an earlier complete letter is not securely separable. The large right symbol has an open upper entry, left downward stroke, rising cup and right stem, read U. A separate horizontal stroke crosses its lower body, marking deletion. The broad lower return may belong to the symbol or retracing; no second independent cancellation layer or subscript is supplied.

The central word has three low connected bodies: an initial u cup, middle n return and flattened final e, read une. A descender entering from the upper edge belongs to the preceding line. The beginning of the following baseline word is clipped at the right edge and is not completed.

The complete central sequence is included. U has an open angled entry and a long right stem; the smaller lower S is visible. The following sur has a short initial curl and low joined u/r bodies. The capital S is followed by a separate short point. De has a large D bowl and compressed terminal e. The last word has a long looped p descender, short r, compact o, c, tall h and final low e, read proche. A curved fragment entering from above is outside scope.

Baseline lisse has a tall looped l, a low i body with detached dark point, two s bodies and a flattened final e. Additional tiny dark points over the left part are not independently formed letters or punctuation. The raised phrase sur S is connected by a long curved leader beginning after lisse and arching over the baseline de. The d oval and looped ascender and the following e remain live beneath that leader. The raised phrase is transcribed as an insertion between lisse and de. The far-right curved hook belongs to the leader; no comma is supplied there.

The abbreviation dim. has a looped d, dotted i, flattened m and a separate terminal point. In the next word, rel and tive are clear; the tiny separate filled mark between l and t can be a highly compressed a or a point, retained locally as a|. without expanding either form. The numeral 1 has a long stem and wide lower foot. The separate following comma is visible and included.

The word le is canceled by a clear horizontal stroke across both letters. The next mathematical glyph has an upper enclosed P-like bowl and two closely adjacent descending stems, one looped on the left; doubled P is favored, with plain P retained because retracing cannot be distinguished securely from an intended doubled stem. A smaller S lies immediately to the lower right and is read as its index. No complete older symbol or revision chronology is supplied for the stem cluster. The following sign has one detached upper bar and a lower cup/cusp with flat right return, rendered literally as barred compressed m. T has a long top bar and separate downward stem. No punctuation is visible after T within this box.

The relation has an upper right-pointing angle and a separate lower slanted bar. A single long numeral stem reads 1. The distinct curved comma at the right is preserved. All three items are complete within the box.

The complete visible formula has codim with no following abbreviation point, an opening parenthesis, Z, a separate comma, S, the inner closing parenthesis, and an upper angle with separate lower slanted bar. The threshold numeral has a curved upper entry, a short nearly vertical middle and a hooked lower return; 2 is favored, with 1 retained because the compressed lower diagonal is unresolved. The final outer right parenthesis is visible and included. Its matching opening parenthesis and the preceding prose lie outside the frozen box and are not completed.

Bottom-left separate foliation 71. The 7 has a curved upper horizontal, descending stem and crossbar. The 1 has an oblique entry and long downward stem. Both are complete and preserved as margin content.
